Name: Drum XPlosion
Overview: Play freeform drums with up to two Xbox controllers. Simulate a full drum kit by using two drum-kit controllers. Newer model-drum controllers are velocity-sensitive! You can customize button/drum assignments; for example, you can assign a second pedal to control the hi-hat or add a second kick drum. Select from more than 50 drum sounds and modify sounds to create new drums, all while watching cool "X-Ploding" visuals.
